singleton_scope.protected_decision: Whether A-share long-lane data is clean enough, and from which usable start year, to allow a later reviewed signal-search preregistration.
applies_to: A-long return and benchmark measurement readiness
A-long time-varying fundamentals coverage and usable-window readiness

creation_reason.reason: After the A-short 5d same-anchor re-audit failed as alpha evidence, the active alpha-search route moves to A-long. A-long must first pass hard data-integrity checks and declare a usable data window before any signal search.

budget_policy.spend_rule: The first future audit run consumes one data-integrity gate unit when executed, regardless of pass, fail, blocked, or limited-usable-window result. It consumes zero alpha-test budget units because it is a data-readiness gate, not a signal-performance test.
budget_policy.no_silent_rescue_rule: Any failed or blocked hard audit check blocks A-long signal search until the data issue is repaired or a new reviewed audit plan changes the data route before execution. Coverage shortfalls declare the usable start year rather than globally failing the audit; missing/invalid ann_date rows are excluded and reported. Thresholds, tables, universe rules, return anchors, benchmark anchors, and the frozen as-of schedule must not be changed after the run to rescue a result.

test_spend_log.result_summary: decision=blocked_missing_required_source; self_tests=6/6; hard_checks_pass=false; usable_start_year=None; signal_search_allowed=false; blocked_reason=missing raw PIT fundamentals / complete PIT universe / dividend and terminal delisting return lineage
test_spend_log.allowed_followup: Repair or replace the A-long data route and create a new reviewed data-integrity audit plan before any signal search; no alpha backtest or production use is authorized.

next_required_actions: Do not start A-long signal search from this blocked audit result.
Repair the data route: raw PIT fundamentals with ann_date/end_date lineage, full PIT universe, dividend/total-return handling, and terminal delisting return lineage are required.
After repair, create a new reviewed data-integrity audit plan or rerun only under a reviewed authorization.
